title: Inability to rename file extensions of files that prior had no extensions

comment.body: The screenshot leaves Search for empty and targets Extension only, so no rename is proposed. To add a suffix to extensionless files, first try copies: select Filename + extension, enable regular expressions, search for `$`, and replace with `.jpg` (or the required extension, including the dot). Check the Renamed preview before Apply. This appends to the filename; it does not convert the file contents, and applying it indiscriminately to files that already have extensions would append another suffix.
